```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r libraries, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Load necessary packages
library(DESeq2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
library(ggrepel)

# TIFF output directory (created automatically)
tiff_dir <- "../results/TIFFs/3_DifferentialExpression"
dir.create(tiff_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## 1. Import files

We load the normalized `dds` object created during the preprocessing and batch correction steps.
```{r load_data}
load(file = "../results/dds_norm.RData")

dds_norm
```

We load the metadata that contains the information about the projects and experimental conditions.
```{r load_metadata}
metadatos <- read.csv(file = "../data/metadata_all.csv", row.names = 1)
head(metadatos)
```

We load the eggNOG functional annotation to map long gene IDs to readable short names (e.g., `pelA`, `cysK`).
```{r load_annotation}
# Gene-name labels are optional: on a first pass this file does not exist yet and
# the volcano falls back to WP_ accessions; re-knit after script 4 to get gene symbols.
# Load eggNOG annotation if available (generated by script 4).
# If not yet present, label_map is empty and make_labels falls back to WP_ IDs.
annot_path <- "../results/advanced_analysis/full_annotated_results.csv"
if (file.exists(annot_path)) {
  full_annotation <- read_csv(annot_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  label_map <- full_annotation %>%
    filter(!is.na(Preferred_name), !Preferred_name %in% c("NA", "-", "")) %>%
    dplyr::select(GeneID, Preferred_name) %>%
    distinct(GeneID, .keep_all = TRUE)
} else {
  message("Note: full_annotated_results.csv not found — run script 4 first for gene name labels.")
  label_map <- tibble(GeneID = character(), Preferred_name = character())
}

# Helper functions
short_wp <- function(x) str_extract(x, "WP_[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")
make_labels <- function(long_ids) {
  wp <- short_wp(long_ids)
  labels <- ifelse(wp %in% label_map$GeneID,
                   label_map$Preferred_name[match(wp, label_map$GeneID)],
                   wp)
  labels[is.na(labels)] <- wp[is.na(labels)]
  labels
}

# Consistent condition color palette (used across all plots)
pal_control   <- "#4575B4"
pal_treatment <- "#D73027"
cond_palette  <- c("Control" = pal_control, "Treatment" = pal_treatment)
pal_diverging <- colorRampPalette(c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027"))(100)
```

---

## 2. Differential Expression Analysis

We check the conditions available in our metadata to set up the comparisons.
```{r check_conditions}
metadatos %>%  
  group_by(Condition) %>% 
  summarise(Count = n())
```

We create the DESeq2 results object, clearly defining the comparison: Treatment vs Control (positive log2FC = higher in Treatment).
*Note: In DESeq2, the standard format is `c("factor", "numerator", "denominator")`.*
```{r deseq_results}
res <- results(dds_norm, contrast = c("Condition", "Treatment", "Control"))
res

# Export the full statistical results file
write.csv(res, file = "../results/deseq_results_Treatment_vs_Control.csv") 
```

### 2.1. Volcano Plot
We create a Volcano plot to get a general view of the differential expression. We set the statistical significance limit (padj < 0.01) and the fold change limit (|log2FC| > 1).

```{r volcano_plot, fig.width=11, fig.height=8.5, warning=FALSE}
# Map long row IDs (lcl|NZ_...) to short gene names (pelA, cysK, ...)
row_labels <- make_labels(rownames(res))

# Only annotate genes that pass both significance cutoffs
sig_mask   <- !is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.01 & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 1
top_labels <- row_labels[sig_mask]

volc <- EnhancedVolcano(res,
               lab             = row_labels,      # short gene names
               selectLab       = top_labels,       # only label DEGs
               x               = "log2FoldChange",
               y               = "padj",
               axisLabSize     = 12,
               pCutoff         = 0.01,
               FCcutoff        = 1,
               col             = c("#BDBDBD",      # NS
                                   "#FDAE61",      # |FC| only
                                   "#74ADD1",      # p-val only
                                   "#1A9641"),     # DEG (both)
               colAlpha        = 0.75,
               pointSize       = 2.5,
               title           = "Volcano Plot",
               titleLabSize    = 14,
               subtitle        = "Treatment vs Control",
               subtitleLabSize = 11,
               captionLabSize  = 9,
               labSize         = 3.2,
               labFace         = "bold",
               labCol          = "black",
               legendLabels    = c("NS", "|log2FC| > 1", "adj-p < 0.01", "DEG"),
               legendPosition  = "right",
               legendLabSize   = 11,
               legendIconSize  = 4,
               drawConnectors  = TRUE,
               widthConnectors = 0.4,
               colConnectors   = "grey50",
               border          = "full",
               borderWidth     = 0.6,
               gridlines.major = TRUE,
               gridlines.minor = FALSE)
volc

ggsave(filename = "../results/volcano_Treatment_vs_Control.pdf",
       plot = volc, width = 11, height = 8.5)
ggsave(filename = file.path(tiff_dir, "volcano_Treatment_vs_Control.tiff"),
       plot = volc, width = 11, height = 8.5, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
```

### 2.2. Extract Differentially Expressed Genes (DEGs)
We filter the results to only keep the genes that pass our significance and fold change limits.

```{r filter_degs}
# Strict filtering
deg <- subset(res, padj < 0.01 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)
paste("Total DEGs found:", nrow(deg)) 

# Subset: Up-regulated genes in the 'Treatment' condition relative to 'Control'
up <- subset(deg, log2FoldChange > 1)
paste("Up-regulated genes:", nrow(up)) 

# Subset: Down-regulated genes
down <- subset(deg, log2FoldChange < (-1))
paste("Down-regulated genes:", nrow(down)) 

# Export DEG list
write.csv(deg, file = "../results/deg_Treatment_vs_Control.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

### 2.3. Expression Heatmap
We generate a heatmap to see the expression patterns of the found DEGs across the samples.

```{r prepare_heatmap_data}
# Extract normalized counts from dds_norm (assuming it was saved in the RData file)
normcounts <- counts(dds_norm, normalized = TRUE)

# Match column names with the replicates in the metadata
colnames(normcounts) <- metadatos$Replicates 

# Dynamically select the samples that belong to this comparison
muestras_contraste <- metadatos %>% 
  filter(Condition %in% c("Control", "Treatment")) %>% 
  pull(Replicates)

subnormcounts <- normcounts[, muestras_contraste]

# Extract DEG IDs to filter the matrix
deg_id <- rownames(deg)
```

```{r plot_heatmap, fig.width=11, fig.height=8.5}
# Condition annotation bar for columns
col_annot    <- data.frame(Condition = metadatos$Condition,
                            row.names = metadatos$Replicates)
annot_colors <- list(Condition = cond_palette)

# Create the heatmap with row scaling (Z-score) and diverging Blue→White→Red palette
hm <- pheatmap(subnormcounts[deg_id, ],
               scale             = "row",
               color             = pal_diverging,
               show_rownames     = FALSE,
               treeheight_row    = 0,
               treeheight_col    = 20,
               annotation_col    = col_annot,
               annotation_colors = annot_colors,
               main              = "Heatmap of DEGs: Treatment vs Control",
               fontsize          = 11,
               border_color      = NA,
               silent            = TRUE)
hm

ggsave(filename = "../results/heatmap_Treatment_vs_Control.pdf",
       plot = hm, width = 11, height = 8.5)
ggsave(filename = file.path(tiff_dir, "heatmap_Treatment_vs_Control.tiff"),
       plot = hm, width = 11, height = 8.5, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
```

## 3. Consolidate DEG lists

Since we are analyzing a single main comparison in this script, we save the DEG IDs in a clean table format for future functional analysis. 

*(Note: This section is ready to scale up if you add lists from other projects later).*

```{r consolidate_degs}
# Load the generated list
BP1_deg <- read.csv(file = "../results/deg_Treatment_vs_Control.csv", row.names = 1)

# Create a data frame with the IDs
deg_summary <- data.frame(
  GeneID = rownames(BP1_deg),
  Contrast = "Treatment_vs_Control"
)

head(deg_summary)

# Export the table ready for enrichment or network analysis
write_csv(deg_summary, file = "../results/common_unique_degs.csv")
```
